name: An Introduction to Working With RNBO and Raspberry Pi
author: George Meikle
description: This package is built around two external objects for generating second-order Markov chains: gtm.markov and gtm.markov~. Markov chains derive the result of the current calculation according to the outcome of those which have preceded it, and have various applications in algorithmic/generative music.

media: Intro to RNBO and Raspberry Pi Course Outline
